001import java.util.HashMap;
002import java.util.Stack;
003
004import pkg_RoomPack.Room;
005
006import pkg_ItemPack.Item;
007import pkg_ItemPack.ItemList;
008
009/**
010 * Classe gÃ©rant le Player
011 *
012 * @author Jeremy
013 */
014public class Player
015{
016    private int                   aHealth;
017    private int                   aMaxWeight; 
018    private ItemList              aInventory;
019    private Room                  aCurrentRoom;
020    private Stack<Room>           aPreviousRooms;
021    private boolean               aStockRooms;  // dÃ©termine si les rooms sont Stackees ou pas
022    
023    /**
024     * Constructeur d'objets de classe Player
025     */
026    public Player()
027    {
028        this.aHealth        = 50;
029        this.aMaxWeight     = 200;
030        this.aInventory     = new ItemList();
031        this.aCurrentRoom   = new Room( "void", null );
032        this.aPreviousRooms = new Stack<Room>();
033        this.aStockRooms    = true;
034    }
035    
036    public void addMaxWeight( final int pWeight )
037    {
038        this.aMaxWeight = this.aMaxWeight + pWeight;
039    }
040    
041    //  ************* ROOM ************
042    
043    /**
044     * @param pRoom Room to set
045     */
046    public void setCurrentRoom( final Room pRoom )
047    {
048        this.aCurrentRoom = pRoom;
049    }
050    
051    public Room getCurrentRoom()
052    {
053        return this.aCurrentRoom;
054    }
055    
056    /**
057     * @param pNextRoom next Room 
058     */
059    public void goNextRoom(final Room pNextRoom)
060    {        
061        if ( this.aStockRooms ) this.aPreviousRooms.push(this.aCurrentRoom);
062        else this.aStockRooms = true;
063        
064        this.aCurrentRoom = pNextRoom;
065    }
066    
067    public boolean noPreviousRoom()
068    {
069        return this.aPreviousRooms.empty();
070    }
071    
072    public Room popPreviousRoom()
073    {
074        return this.aPreviousRooms.pop();
075    }
076    
077    public void deletePreviousRooms()
078    {
079        this.aPreviousRooms.clear();
080        this.aStockRooms = false; // pour ne pas stacker la prochaine room
081    }
082    
083    // ********** INVENTORY **************
084    
085    public Item searchInventory( final String pName )
086    {
087        return this.aInventory.getItem(pName);
088    }
089    
090    public boolean pickUpItem( final Item pItem )
091    {
092        this.aInventory.addItem(pItem);
093        
094        if ( this.isOverMaxWeight() )
095            return true;
096        return false;
097    }
098    
099    public void dropItem( final Item pItem )
100    {
101        this.aInventory.removeItem(pItem.getName());
102    }
103    
104    public boolean isOverMaxWeight()
105    {
106        int vWeight = this.aInventory.getTotalWeight();
107        return vWeight > this.aMaxWeight;
108    }
109    
110    public int getTotalValue()
111    {
112        return this.aInventory.getTotalPrice();
113    }
114    
115    public String itemList()
116    {
117        return this.aInventory.getItemString();
118    }
119    
120    public boolean emptyInv()
121    {
122        if ( this.aInventory.empty() )
123            return true;
124        return false;
125    }
126    
127    public boolean hasItem(final String pItem)
128    {
129        return this.aInventory.hasItem(pItem);
130    }
131}
